title: bbyj's Pet Bunny
description: Tame, command, and breed rabbits with unique personalities in this vanilla-friendly pet mod.
body:
# 🐇 bbyj's Pet Bunny 1.5.0-summer-preview!

> Turn Minecraft’s rabbits into true companions with personalities, abilities, homes, equipment, and long-term growth.

💬 [Submit Suggestions & Issues](https://github.com/Logeaddd/Pet-rabbit-Q-A-and-Feedback/issues)  
🌐 [Join Our Discord](https://discord.gg/U2SkuVwk)  
☕ [Support Development on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/bbyjmrjinjin)

![bunnies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83933fb16ea77590e71c8e8993701ada6c57813b_0.webp)

## 🌟 About Pet Bunny

**Pet Bunny** is a bunny-themed companion mod built around taming, personality, growth, daily life, and adventure.

Every bunny has its own appearance, personality, abilities, Starbond level, equipment, and behavior. Your bunny can stay at home, follow you across dimensions, help during combat or exploration, carry supplies, sleep in its own hutch, and grow stronger through the time you spend together.

Pet Bunny is designed to remain bunny-friendly: no rabbit meat, no rabbit feet, and no harmful bunny products in bunny-related rewards.

## 🏡 Life With Your Bunny

After taming a bunny with a **Dandelion** or **Carrot**, you can choose how it should live:

| Mode | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| 🧺 Stay | Remains in place and does not join normal movement or combat |
| 🐾 Follow | Travels with its owner and joins supported companion activities |
| 🌿 Free Roaming | Explores nearby areas while remaining connected to its owner and home |

Tamed bunnies can sleep, breed, wear armor, use a 36-slot backpack, gain Starbond, live in hutches, shed fur, and help with combat, farming, archaeology, treasure, or support effects.

## 🎭 Bunny Types & Personalities

| Bunny Type | Personality | Companion Ability |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🤍 White Bunny | Cautious | Detects danger, warns its owner, and provides night support |
| 🖤 Black Bunny | Gentle | Provides defensive and recovery support |
| 💛 Yellow Bunny | Curious | Searches for treasure and helps with archaeology |
| 🍀 Small White Bunny | Lucky | Improves luck and Curious Bunny treasure results |
| 🌱 Yellow Gray Bunny | Lazy | Helps nearby crops and saplings grow |
| 🔥 Golden Bunny | Aggressive | Actively attacks hostile mobs and grows during combat |
| 💙 Blue Bunny | Brave | Follows its owner into battle and can transform |
| ✨ White Gray Bunny | Weird | Summons guards, releases lightning, and can revive itself |

## ⭐ Starbond System

Every tamed bunny has a Starbond level from **Lv.1 to Lv.10**. Starbond grows through companionship, exploration, healing, combat, visiting new biomes and dimensions, and personality abilities.

Higher levels improve health, damage, speed, cooldowns, and personality abilities.

The redesigned bunny-shaped HUD displays the bunny’s name, level, health, personality, and progress. Its appearance changes while the bunny is sleeping, fighting, worried, or critically injured.

## 🎒 Homes, Equipment & Helpers

![bunny house](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f09d9484977005a8a5f9ec83e33799817dd9c023_0.webp)

- Bunnies can wear armor and use a real 36-slot backpack.
- Bunny Hutches give free-roaming bunnies a place to sleep and recover.
- Bunny Toilets store Bunny Poop and Bunny Urine when the optional system is enabled.
- Bunny Poop Cleaners use a 32-slot backpack and can clean with shovels or collect urine with bottles.
- Bunnies naturally shed fur, with optional Serene Seasons support.

## 🧶 Starfluff Tuft

The Starfluff Tuft is crafted with an Ender Pearl surrounded by eight pieces of any bunny fur.

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Sneak + right-click a companion | Bind or unbind it |
| Right-click while holding the item | Recall all bound companions |
| Hold one in both hands | The main-hand Starfluff Tuft takes priority |

Each Starfluff Tuft stores up to **8 bunnies or Bunny Poop Cleaners**, works across dimensions, has a five-second cooldown, and displays bound companion names in its tooltip.

## ☀️ Summer Preview

![summer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/563bb55544b22327d463bf294e79e648e147ef5c_0.webp)

The `1.5.0 Summer Preview` introduces a limited seasonal logo, six bunny cooling mats, six small parasols, six giant parasols, the Starfluff Tuft, and a completely redesigned Starbond HUD.

## ⚙️ Optional Bunny Waste

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `/petrabbit urine true` | Enable Bunny Poop and Bunny Urine |
| `/petrabbit urine false` | Disable Bunny Poop and Bunny Urine |

## 🌍 Available Versions

| Minecraft | Loader | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1.20.1 | Forge | Current gameplay baseline |
| 1.21.8 | Fabric | Preview version under active testing |

Forge worlds cannot be converted directly into Fabric worlds. Fabric players should create a new world with the matching version.

# 📖 Commands

## 🐇 Bunny Management

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/bunnyname <name>` | Rename the bunny you are looking at |
| `/bunnytp <name>` | Recall one owned bunny |
| `/bunnytp <team>` | Recall a saved bunny team |
| `/bunnytp all` | Recall all available owned bunnies |
| `/bt ...` | Short alias for `/bunnytp` |
| `/bunnyremove <name>` | Permanently delete a bunny |

> ⚠️ `/bunnyremove` cannot be undone through recall.

## 👥 Bunny Teams

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/bunnyteam list` | List all teams |
| `/bunnyteam show <team>` | Show team members |
| `/bunnyteam set <team> <names>` | Create or replace a team |
| `/bunnyteam add <team> <names>` | Add bunnies to a team |
| `/bunnyteam remove <team> <names>` | Remove bunnies from a team |
| `/bunnyteam delete <team>` | Delete a team |

## 🏠 Bunny Hutch & Cleaner

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/bunnyhutch bind <bunny name>` | Bind the hutch you are looking at |
| `/bunnyhutch unbind` | Remove the hutch binding |
| `/bunnypoopcleaner call <name>` | Recall a cleaner |
| `/bunnypoopcleaner name <cleaner> <new name>` | Rename a cleaner |
| `/bunnypoopcleaner area <x1> <z1> <x2> <z2>` | Set its work area |
| `/bunnypoopcleaner clear` | Clear its work area |
| `/bunnypoopcleaner info` | Display cleaner information |

## 🛠️ Administrator Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/petrabbit config` | Show the current configuration |
| `/petrabbit list` | List loaded tamed bunnies |
| `/petrabbit reset` | Reset global configuration |
| `/petrabbit friendlyprotect true/false` | Toggle friendly-fire protection |
| `/petrabbit predatorprotect true/false` | Toggle predator protection |
| `/petrabbit forage fullhealth true/false` | Toggle full-health foraging |
| `/petrabbit follow speednear <value>` | Set close follow speed |
| `/petrabbit follow speedfar <value>` | Set long-distance follow speed |

Personality and individual bunny attributes can also be configured through `/petrabbit`. Minecraft’s command suggestions display the available Starbond, health, damage, speed, cooldown, farming, archaeology, spawning, and protection settings.
